UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Profile for Yajman (Devotee) and Pandit Ji (Priest) including mobile OTP verification status, gotra, address, and Pandit Ji availability.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the user.

name.description: Full name of the Yajman or Pandit Ji.

phone.description: 10-digit Indian mobile number verified via OTP flow.

role.description: Active role selected by the user.

preferredPuja.description: Default or preferred Puja service name.

isPanditOnline.description: Online/Offline availability toggle for Pandit Ji dashboard.

otpVerified.description: Whether mobile number OTP verification is completed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

PujaBooking.title: PujaBooking
PujaBooking.description: A Puja booking connecting Yajman and Pandit Ji with date, time slot, price calculation, payment method, and platform commission split.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this booking record.

yajmanName.description: Name of the Yajman (Devotee) for Sankalp.

yajmanPhone.description: Mobile number of the Yajman for direct call by Pandit Ji.

yajmanAddress.description: Address where the Puja/Havan will be performed.

gotra.description: Gotra of the Yajman for Vaidik Sankalp.

pujaId.description: Identifier of the selected Puja service.

pujaTitle.description: Title of the selected Puja (e.g., Bagalamukhi Havan Poojan).

pujaDate.description: Selected date in YYYY-MM-DD or readable format.

timeSlot.description: Selected muhurat time slot (e.g., 06:00 AM, 08:00 AM).

includeSamagri.description: Whether Shuddh Havan & Puja Samagri is included.

specialInstructions.description: Special instructions or Sankalp notes from Yajman.

totalAmount.description: Total amount paid by Yajman in INR.

panditPayout.description: Net payout to Pandit Ji in INR (Total - Platform Commission).

bookingStatus.description: Lifecycle status of the Puja booking.

panditName.description: Assigned Vaidik Acharya / Pandit Ji name.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was created (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when booking was last updated (FieldValue.serverTimestamp()).

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated user profile and Pandit Ji online/offline status for each authenticated user.

/bookings/{bookingId}.description: Stores Puja bookings scoped to the authenticated userId with full price and commission breakdown.
